name: Neutrogena Oil Free Acne Face Wash 80ml
description:
Product Name: Neutrogena Oil-Free Acne Face Wash
Quantity: 80ml
Item Form: Liquid
Skin Type: Acne-prone skin

Key Features & Benefits

Deep Cleansing: Leaves skin feeling clean and refreshed

Dermatologist Recommended: Effective acne-fighting formula

Gentle & Safe: Alcohol-free, oil-free, and residue-free

Non-Comedogenic: Does not clog pores

Directions for Use

Cleanse twice a day

Apply to hands, add water, and work into a lather

Gently massage onto face

Rinse thoroughly

Package Contents

1 × Neutrogena Oil-Free Acne Face Wash (80ml)
